title: Name validation in AnimationLibraryManager doesn't show name conflict warning
body:
### Tested versions

I checked it happens in:
- v4.6.1.stable.mono.official [14d19694e]
- v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 680M (radeonsi, rembrandt, LLVM 21.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.18.9-200.fc43.x86_64) - AMD Ryzen 7 6800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 14.85 GiB memory

### Issue description

This is such a minor issue and maybe I shouldn't even be reporting this, but it's something that's confused me for like two minutes before realizing what was happening, so I figured I should mention it.

The thing is, when managing animations while in the Animation tab, renaming an existing one will not show any error message if a name conflict occurs. I found that confusing and I thought my renaming was simply not being applied.

Renaming the animation from somewhere else does give you an error popup so I'd say this is not the intended behaviour.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a4e7ae6b-e239-4a8d-88ad-da86fe11fd16

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project or open an existing one in Godot.
2. Create a new scene and add an `AnimationPlayer` node in its hiearchy.
3. Double click it to open the `Animation` tab.
4. Click `Animation > New...` and enter the name `anim_1`.
5. Repeat the previous step, but this time enter the name `anim_2`.
6. Go to `Animation > Manage Animations`, select one of the two animations you created and press enter to rename it. Rename it to the other animation name. Observe how you can't, but no popup or error message appears.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No need; reproducible in any project.
